sentences.en: Hundreds of millions of people have spent the last year waiting.

sentences.en: Waiting for it to be safe to enter workplaces.

sentences.en: Waiting to see if loved ones will survive their stay in a hospital.
sentences.zh: 等待着看挚爱之人能否在医院中挺过难关。

sentences.en: Waiting to see if lost jobs will return.
sentences.zh: 等待着失去的工作是否会失而复得。

sentences.en: Perhaps you have caught yourself daydreaming about the moment everything returns to normal.
sentences.zh: 也许你发现自己曾在白日梦中幻想着一切恢复正常的那一刻。

sentences.en: When we can go about our lives without masks,
sentences.zh: 当我们可以摘下口罩过上日常生活，

sentences.en: sit in a crowded theater without worry,
sentences.zh: 毫无顾虑地坐在拥挤的剧院里，

sentences.en: meet friends in our homes without fear.
sentences.zh: 无所畏惧地在家中与朋友相聚。

sentences.en: What will it feel like that day?
Will there be a surge of joy?
This week on Hidden Brain, the agony of waiting
sentences.zh: 本周的“隐藏的大脑”，将探讨等待的煎熬

sentences.en: and the strange things that happen in our minds when we experience relief.
sentences.zh: 以及当我们体验到解脱时，脑海中发生的奇异变化。

sentences.en: In books and movies, the experience of relief usually follows a period of waiting.
sentences.zh: 在书籍和电影中，如释重负的体验通常发生在一阵等待之后。

sentences.en: We're going to mix up that order on today's show.
sentences.zh: 在今天的节目里，我们要调一下这个顺序。
我们首先来看看如释重负的感觉。

sentences.en: And later in the show, we'll explore the psychology of waiting
sentences.zh: 而在节目稍后，我们将探讨等待的心理学

sentences.en: and what new research reveals about how we can wait well.
sentences.zh: 以及最新研究揭示的如何才能更好地等待。

sentences.en: Our story about relief comes from Jamie Spurway.
sentences.zh: 我们关于如释重负的故事来自杰米·斯帕韦。

sentences.en: For five years, Jamie worked as a tour guide,
sentences.zh: 五年里，杰米一直担任导游，

sentences.en: mostly in the Middle East and Europe, but also in South Africa.
sentences.zh: 主要在中东和欧洲，也有南非。

sentences.en: One of the places he often brought tourists was called the Garden Route,
sentences.zh: 他经常带游客去的一个地方叫做花园大道，

sentences.en: where the safaris boast an incredible range of big game.
sentences.zh: 那里的野生动物园以种类繁多的大型猎物而自豪。

sentences.en: You're seeing an extraordinary array of animals.
sentences.zh: 你会看到令人惊叹的各种动物。
斑马、长颈鹿、犀牛、河马、黑斑羚。

sentences.zh: 杰米通常用路虎车载着游客四处参观。

sentences.en: They were completely open on the sides.
sentences.zh: 车身两侧是完全敞开的。
